import mpmath as mp
import numpy as np

import scipy.stats as stats
from scipy.stats._constants import _XMAX

# Target points
x_pdf = mp.mpf('1e200')
xs_log = [mp.mpf('2e18'), mp.mpf('1e200'), mp.mpf(str(float(_XMAX)))]

# SciPy computations (float64)
xf_pdf = 1e200
pdf_val = stats.cauchy.pdf(xf_pdf)

logpdf_vals = [stats.cauchy.logpdf(float(x)) for x in xs_log]

# High-precision references for logpdf using mpmath
# Cauchy pdf: 1/pi * 1/(1+x^2)
# logpdf: -log(pi) - log(1+x^2)
mp.mp.dps = 80
pi = mp.pi
ref_logpdf = []
for x in xs_log:
    ref = -mp.log(pi) - mp.log(1 + x*x)
    ref_logpdf.append(ref)

# Convert refs to float for comparison/recording (still identifies -inf when SciPy fails)
ref_logpdf_f = [float(r) for r in ref_logpdf]

# Emit probe records
probe('pdf_at_1e200', float(pdf_val))
for i, v in enumerate(logpdf_vals):
    probe(f'logpdf_at_xs_log[{i}]', float(v))
    probe(f'ref_logpdf_at_xs_log[{i}]', ref_logpdf_f[i])

# Also record which x values were used
probe('x_log_values_float', [float(x) for x in xs_log])
